## [Smelly odor](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64f256f6feb3477173fd473a)
The rug had a terrible smell that we are still trying to get rid of. We opened our windows for 3 straight days, ran a fan in the room and it still has an odor similar to cat urine every time we vacuum it. The rug is also a yellow cream, not an off white as the pictures show on the website. If shipping were not so expensive, it would be going back. Unfortunately, we'll have to keep it and hope the smell subsides eventually

August 18, 2023

Hi there, we're sorry to hear that the rug you received has an odor. Typically, if a rug is received and has an odor, once it is unrolled the odor should dissipate within a week. If you have any further questions. please reach out to our Customer Experience team at support@luluandgeorgia.com.
